snippet.title: Audio Trip: Swanky Song Pack DLC | Announcement Trailer | Meta Quest Platform
snippet.description:
💃 Audio Trip: Swanky Song Pack DLC is OUT NOW on the Meta Quest store for $4.99! 🕺

Take a trip with a modern twist of vintage glamour in our newest DLC: Swanky Song Pack! Enjoy the vibes with 5 sassy songs by Laura Leighe.

This pack’s choreography is a collaboration with OkDisplay, with a range of difficulties, including Cardio levels by Coopalooper, for a total of 20 NEW TRIPS.

Full tracklist:
"Boys Just Wanna Have Fun"
"Cherry On Top"
"Howlin' At the Moon"
"Love Undercover"
"Swanky"

Available now: https://metaque.st/3OjIvZF
